ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (17) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Насилие» (nasiliye) is 'violence' and «разумный» (razumnyy) 'reasonable' throughout; «не противься злому» (ne protiv'sya zlomu) is 'do not resist evil', translated from Tolstoy's Russian of Matthew 5:38–39. In the fourth thought the switch from plural educated people to a singular 'him' who is whistled 'into the collar' («под хомут», pod khomut, a horse collar) is kept as printed.
